text: Hash chaining each Chronicle entry to its predecessor with a persisted per-tool head digest makes any modification, deletion, or reordering of history break the chain at a determinable point, at the cost of one hash per append.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7314479

isBasedOn.name: Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes

abstract: Give each entry a digest over its own content and its predecessor's digest, and persist the current head digest per tool. Append cost is one hash. Verification is a linear scan. Any modification, deletion, or reordering of history breaks the chain at a determinable point.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: a minimal delta against the Mosaic design at commit 2d920ce
